name: Three Cliffs Bay Holiday Park
accommodation: Premium touring pitches, glamping tents sleeping up to five, traditional camping
dogs: Welcome in the glamping tents; check for touring pitches
beachAccess: Above Three Cliffs Bay; glamping tents a short walk from the beach
confirmedFeatures: Pitches with fire pit, picnic table, hook-up and water point, Bistro 1948, firewood packs, reception 8am-8pm
overview: Three Cliffs Bay Holiday Park sits above the sands of Three Cliffs Bay, just east of Oxwich. It offers premium touring pitches with fire pits and hook-ups, glamping tents that sleep up to five, and traditional camping, and its Bistro 1948 serves breakfasts and pizzas.
surfTripFit: You can walk down to Three Cliffs, and Oxwich Bay is a short drive away when it's working better.
